command_line:
set -eu
Rscript --vanilla - "/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79155211/inputs/dataset_14232302-ba4a-43f0-83b1-abb7ef050353.dat" > result.tsv <<'EOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.delim(args[1], header=TRUE, sep="\t", check.names=FALSE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE, na.strings="")
d <- d[!is.na(d$Efficacy) & d$Efficacy %in% c("PR", "SD", "PD") & !is.na(d$BMI), , drop=FALSE]
d$y <- as.integer(d$Efficacy == "PR")
fit <- glm(y ~ BMI, data=d, family=binomial)
cat(sprintf("%.12f\n", AIC(fit)))
EOF
